# Hockey Computindo

> Premium themes for Astro, Starlight, Docusaurus, Next.js, React, Angular, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Gatsby, Blazor, Bludit, Eleventy, Jekyll, Python, and .NET. Also the maker of 10 open-source SSG engines: AX, CAX (C), DAX (.NET), GAX (Go), PYCORA (Python), LUAX (Lua), BAX (Bash), ONTA (Perl), Markdownuts (PHP), and Axcora Framework. Ownership, not rental: one-time purchase, full source code, 90+ Lighthouse, SEO structure included.

Hockey Computindo is a theme shop and web architecture studio. We sell curated, hand-built static site themes that you own 100%. No subscriptions. No bloat: one CSS file, one JS file, no heavy dependencies. We also build custom web systems (headless commerce, booking, SSG, AI automation) via Fiverr escrow.

Last updated: November 2, 2026.

## Themes

- [All Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/): Browse the full catalog of free and premium themes.

- [Free Themes](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/free/): Free themes to download and try.

## SSG Engines by Axcora

- [AX SSG](https://ax.axcora.com): Modern static site generator by Axcora. No `node_modules`, instant setup, blazing fast. Free and open source.
- [CAX — Pure C SSG](https://cax.axcora.com): Static site generator written in pure C. Jekyll-inspired frontmatter, Liquid-like templating, 0.4s for 1000 pages. The engine that powers this site. Free and open source.
- [DAX — .NET SSG](https://dax.axcora.com): .NET static site generator by Axcora. Pure C# engine, zero NPM, for content-driven .NET sites. Powers Dax Pro. Free and open source.
- [GAX — Go SSG](https://gax.axcora.com): Minimal Go static site generator by Axcora. Fast, simple, SEO-ready. A lightweight Hugo alternative for blogs, docs, and portfolios. Free and open source.
- [PYCORA — Python SSG](https://pycora.axcora.com): Python static site generator by Axcora. Fast, minimal, elegant. Powers Pycora Pro. Free and open source.
- [LUAX — Lua SSG](https://luax.axcora.com): Lua static site generator by Axcora for minimal, clean project sites and blogs. Free and open source.
- [BAX — Bash SSG](https://bax.axcora.com): Static site generator built with Batch/Bash. Zero dependencies, cross-platform, SEO-friendly. Free and open source.
- [ONTA — Perl SSG](https://onta.axcora.com): Perl static site generator by Axcora. Optimized network template architecture for speed and security. Free and open source.
- [Markdownuts](https://markdownuts.axcora.com): PHP Markdown + YAML flat-file CMS by Axcora. No database, fast, SEO-ready. Free and open source.
- [Axcora Framework](https://www.hockeycomputindo.com/themes/others/axcora-framework/): All-in-one SSG and CSS framework built in C. Components with auto minify. Free and open source.
